known_facts.fact: The email requests an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 readiness plan for an organization named Northwind Orchard Analytics and explicitly labels the request and its details as fictional synthetic test evidence.
The request describes a fictional analytics software company with 24 employees and an initial readiness plan desired within eight weeks of an agreed kickoff.

The proposed scope covers development, hosting, operation, and support of the analytics platform, including employee devices, identity management, cloud infrastructure, and supporting business processes. Customer-managed networks are proposed exclusions requiring review.
The request identifies an office in Tashkent, remote employees in Uzbekistan, and cloud-hosted production services; it says the cloud provider and hosting region are not documented.

The email provides synthetic test evidence about governance, technical practices, and awareness, including reported counts and missing records; those details are unverified and are not treated as audit or compliance findings.
